tests.name: Quick Check
tests.description: Timed check on Photography and Digital Art in Fine Art

questions.question: Create a series of experimental studies exploring photography and digital art in fine art. Annotate your process.
questions.correctAnswer: A range of experimental studies showing different approaches to photography and digital art in fine art, each annotated with media, technique and purpose. Show development from initial experiments to refined outcomes.

questions.question: Research an artist or designer who works with photography and digital art in fine art. Write a critical analysis of their approach and explain how it has informed your own work.
questions.correctAnswer: A critical analysis naming a specific artist/designer, using specialist vocabulary, explaining their context and approach, and making clear connections to personal work.

questions.question: Evaluate the effectiveness of your experiments with photography and digital art in fine art. Which approaches were most successful and why?
questions.correctAnswer: A reflective evaluation identifying successful and less successful experiments, explaining WHY using technical and conceptual language, and showing how evaluation led to further refinement.

tests.name: Extended Practice
tests.description: Self-marked extended answers on Photography and Digital Art in Fine Art

questions.correctAnswer: A grade 9 response will: demonstrate intentional use of camera/digital tools; show understanding of visual language; annotate with specialist vocabulary (depth of field, exposure, composite); reference relevant artists; evaluate ethical considerations. Mark scheme: AO1 (develop through investigation) + AO2 (refine through experimentation) + AO3 (record ideas and observations) + AO4 (present personal response) = total marks
questions.explanation: Extended answer: aim for the mark-scheme points, in order, with the command word addressed.
